description: An immutable exact target-local binding of one profile digest. It contains no activation state and no resolution identifier. target_context_id is deliberately constrained to the intersection of the Network Context-id domain and pinned Seed identifier domain so the declared projection is total. target_state_root is the exact Seed state_root for this activation binding; the Network profile defines no ambient lifetime beyond that exact binding. A fresh Seed ResolutionRequest is constructed from the declared projection; applicability is derived only from its target-local Seed result.
title: ASET exact local profile binding
